const allowed=new Set(['WORK_EXPERIENCE','DECLARED_SKILL','EDUCATION','CERTIFICATION','REQUIREMENT_VALIDATION']); const prepared=$('Prepare PROMPT-IA-03-v1').first().json; const ids=new Set(prepared.valid_experience_ids||[]); const topics=(prepared.valid_topics||[]).filter(t=>t.length>=3||/[#.+]/.test(t)); const evidence=prepared.valid_work_evidence||[]; const norm=value=>String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/\p{Diacritic}/gu,'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' '); const words=value=>new Set((norm(value).match(/[a-z0-9#+.]{4,}/g)||[]).filter(word=>!['para','como','esta','este','desde','entre','sobre','donde','hacer','hacia','durante'].includes(word))); const topicAllowed=value=>{const normalized=norm(value);return topics.some(topic=>normalized.includes(norm(topic))||norm(topic).includes(normalized));}; const workEvidenceAllowed=q=>{if(!q.experience_id||!ids.has(q.experience_id)||norm(q.evidence).length<12)return false; const supplied=words(`${q.evidence} ${q.question}`); return evidence.some(item=>{if(item.experience_id!==q.experience_id)return false; const source=words(item.text); let shared=0; for(const word of source)if(supplied.has(word))shared++; return shared>=Math.min(4,Math.max(2,Math.ceil(source.size*0.25)));});}; const protectedTerms=/(edad|género|genero|estado civil|nacionalidad|religión|religion|discapacidad|orientación sexual|orientacion sexual|embarazo)/i; const issues=[]; d.questions.forEach((q,index)=>{const label=`Q${index+1}`; if(!q||typeof q.topic!=='string'||!q.topic.trim())issues.push(`${label}_TOPIC`); if(!q||typeof q.question!=='string'||!q.question.trim())issues.push(`${label}_QUESTION`); else if(protectedTerms.test(q.question))issues.push(`${label}_PROTECTED_TERM`); if(!q||!allowed.has(q.source_type))issues.push(`${label}_SOURCE_TYPE`); else if(q.source_type==='WORK_EXPERIENCE'){if(!workEvidenceAllowed(q))issues.push(`${label}_WORK_EVIDENCE`);}else if(!topicAllowed(q.topic))issues.push(`${label}_UNGROUNDED_TOPIC`);}); return [{json:issues.length?{valid:false,error:`IA03_INVALID_OUTPUT_OR_EVIDENCE:${issues.join(',')}`}:{valid:true,result_json:JSON.stringify(d)}}];
